title: 第18章 郁凌打架了
novel_title: 修仙回来后我儿孙满堂了
content_zh:
“郁凌，打球去？”张刚一把拉住放学就朝外跑的郁凌，“怎么回事？你最近一放学就跑，叫你开黑你不去，打球也不积极。”

    郁凌揉了把脸，“还不是最近搬的新家有点远，我每天光是坐地铁和公车都得花上一个小时。”

    生活是富裕了，可是学校却离得远了，简直是欲哭无泪。

    “不就是一个小时嘛，强子每天也是这样跑的，你都好久没跟我们玩了，玩一把？”张刚揽住郁凌的肩膀，怎么都不想将郁凌给放走。

    毕竟这家伙可是他们的主力军啊。

    郁凌想了想自己似乎确实是每天都赶着回家，很久没有和小伙伴们耍了。看了看在一边等着的兄弟们，他顿时豪气的说：“成，今天咱们就好好玩几把，一会儿请你们喝水。”

    “嘿，郁凌，不错嘛，搬新家了，人也发财了，居然会请咱喝水了。”张刚开着玩笑。

    以前郁凌和他们玩球，从来都是自带水壶，可不会和他们一样一身热汗的去买冰水饮料喝。

    “什么话？我在你们眼中就是这么小气的人？”郁凌不高兴了，虽然知道张刚没有恶意，可这家伙是真不会说话。

    张刚连唉了几声，“我可没有这个意思，行，今天的水就你请了，就当是这段时间不跟我们玩补偿我们的。”

    郁凌家的条件他们了解一些，前段时间状况不太好，郁凌整个人都是焦虑的，他们也不敢问，只能陪着他打球，发泄一下情绪。

    这段时间看上去应该是他父亲好了些吧，人也相比之前要开朗了不少。

    但是还是得给这家伙面子，于是便应承了下来。

    几人来到球场，学校有两个篮球场，分别在操场和后门处，为了不和一群人抢那新建成的篮球场，郁凌他们都是固定在学校后门的旧操场打球。

    郁凌玩得正酣，便听到了嘈杂声，转身看去，强子正和一群穿着球衣，拿着篮球的人在争执。

    郁凌挥了挥手示意了一下，所有人都围了上去。

    “怎么回事？”郁凌盯着那个带头的男生，嘴里却问着强子。

    “他们要我们让位置！”强子气愤的说，自己玩得好好的，这几个人一过来，便拽住了他，要求他们将位置腾出来给他们，凭什么？
content_en:
"Yu Ling, are you going to play ball?" Zhang Gang grabbed Yu Ling, who was running outside after school, "What's going on? You ran away as soon as school was over recently. You didn't go when I asked you to play black, and you weren't active in playing ball."

Yu Ling rubbed his face, "It's not that the new home I recently moved to is a bit far away. It takes me an hour every day just to take the subway and bus."

Life is rich, but the school is far away, and I feel like crying without tears.

"Isn't it just an hour? Qiangzi runs like this every day. You haven't played with us for a long time. How about playing?" Zhang Gang put his arms around Yu Ling's shoulders and didn't want to let Yu Ling go.

After all, this guy is their main force.

Yu Ling thought for a while and it seemed that he was indeed rushing home every day and hadn't played with his friends for a long time.Looking at the brothers waiting aside, he suddenly said proudly: "Okay, let's have some fun today, and I'll treat you to a drink later."

"Hey, Yu Ling, it's not bad. I moved to a new house and got rich, so you'll actually treat me to a drink." Zhang Gang joked.

When Yu Ling used to play ball with them, he always brought his own water bottle. He would not buy ice water drinks like them when he was sweating.

"What are you saying? Am I such a stingy person in your eyes?" Yu Ling was unhappy. Although he knew that Zhang Gang had no ill intentions, this guy really couldn't speak.

Zhang Gang sighed several times, "I didn't mean that. Okay, you'll pay for the water today. Just treat it as compensation for not playing with us during this period."

They knew a little about the conditions of Yu Ling's family. The situation was not very good some time ago. Yu Ling was all anxious. They didn't dare to ask. They could only play ball with him to vent their emotions.

His father seems to have gotten better during this period, and he is much more cheerful than before.

But I still had to give this guy face, so I agreed.

Several people came to the court. The school has two basketball courts, one at the playground and one at the back entrance. In order not to compete with a group of people for the newly built basketball court, Yu Ling and the others always played on the old playground at the back entrance of the school.

Yu Ling was having fun when he heard the noise. He turned around and saw that Qiangzi was arguing with a group of people wearing jerseys and holding basketballs.

Yu Ling waved his hand and everyone gathered around.

"What's going on?" Yu Ling stared at the boy in the lead, but asked Qiangzi.

"They want us to give up our seats!" Qiangzi said angrily. He was having a good time. As soon as these people came over, they grabbed him and asked them to give up their seats to them. Why?
title_en: Chapter 18 Yu Ling got into a fight
